title: cicercula sativa var. angustata
intro: Cicercula sativa var. angustata, commonly known as Angustata Burdock, is a variety of the burdock plant, a biennial herb native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Angustata Burdock include its ability to stimulate the appetite, improve bowel function, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include inulin, arabinose, and other glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
